profile.deleteConfirm: Delete the profile “{name}” and all its data? This cannot be undone.

profile.added: Profile “{name}” added. Switch to it from the login screen.

lock.title: PIN or password
lock.off: No lock: anyone using this browser can open this profile.

storage.noEstimate: This browser doesn't report how much space is available.

engines.memory: memory only (nothing is kept after closing the tab)

storage.cachesHint: Downloaded extras kept for offline use. Nexus itself stays installed.

cachesCleared.=0: There were no caches to clear

storage.noAppData: No app has stored anything yet.
storage.systemHint: Settings, notifications, search index, log and more.
storage.discardConfirm: Delete this unreadable record for good?
storage.quarantineEmpty: Nothing here: all stored data could be read.

apps.noDefaults: No defaults yet. Choose “Always use this app” when opening a file.

privacy.local: Everything in Nexus stays in this browser. There is no account and no server.
privacy.noTracking: No analytics, no tracking, no ads.
privacy.network: Nexus only goes online for things you set up yourself, like an AI server.
privacy.searchHint: What you opened from search, to rank it higher.

backup.exportHint: One .nexus-backup file with all your files, settings and app data. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.passwordWarning: With a password the backup is encrypted. If you forget the password, the backup cannot be opened by anyone.

backup.encrypted: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password.
